text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — CloudPartner just listed our connector in their cloud catalog. Need a short 30-min webinar + an on-demand benchmark blog to drive marketplace leads. Thoughts on timeline? Ideally publish benchmark + listing promo in 2 weeks.
Samir Patel: Congrats! +1 to a benchmark. Can we reuse last quarter's LLM latency/cost data? Will need updated cost-per-token numbers and sequence-length breakouts.
Eli Johnson: I’ll grab the partner lead-handoff spec. They require a webhook endpoint + UTM params. @Ruth Vargas can Sales triage MQLs from the marketplace?
Ruth Vargas: Yes, Sales can triage. We need a lead-score mapping and SFDC tags. Send the CSV mapping of lead fields and I'll prep validation rules.
Maya Chen: Proposed plan: week 1 — publish benchmark exec summary + raw evals; week 2 — blog + 30-min joint webinar with Partner; week 2–3 — gated demo + marketplace CTA. Who can own webinar slides? :calendar:
Samir Patel: I can own slides + benchmark charts. I’ll update model versions and prompt list. @Eli Johnson can you share a sample webhook payload so we can test?
Eli Johnson: Sample payload (mock):
```
{"email":"alice@example.com","company":"Acme","utm_source":"cloud_partner","utm_campaign":"marketplace_listing","lead_score":""}
```
I’ll post the full spec in #partner-ops and spin up a dev endpoint next Tue. cc @devops-bot for certs and TLS.
Ruth Vargas: Scoring proposal: demo_request=80, pricing_question=60, general_interest=30. SFDC tag: partner_marketplace. I’ll add validation rules and notify SDR queue.
Maya Chen: Quick asks before Monday: 1) marketing headline for listing (50–80 chars) 2) preferred webinar slot — Tue or Thu 11am PT? 3) I’ll drop a tracking sheet link and invite. :rocket:
Samir Patel: I prefer Thu. Draft headline: "Run LLMs reliably across hosted & private infra — benchmark + demo" — will refine.
Eli Johnson: Noted. I’ll send mock payloads and endpoint URL by EOD Mon.
Ruth Vargas: +1 Thu. I’ll sync SFDC mappings once I get the CSV.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — I’ll create the calendar invite once slides are shared and ping Partner PM for moderator confirmation. Will also post the tracking doc here. /done
